comparison: Read-only git diff 1c56ab0..53cb20a city.js/city-apartments.js; current look.js vs preserved C9 source/math.

geometry.coordinateConvention: All physical dimensions below W1 shop-local, in metres; rigid yaw/frame preserve distances. Pixel projection 960x600 FOV58, current fixed shop-interior camera.
geometry.interpretation: Suspended category board is not wall-contacting and projects mainly left of the reviewed x180..286 ROI. Chilled-case top lightbox really meets wall; its top-wall contact projects near y228. Do not attribute y192..202 band to either solely from these bounds; runtime sample/raycast evidence required.

lights.material: M.lamp = mat.emissive(#ffd9a0,1.25), factory returns MeshBasicMaterial with toneMapped=false. Self-lit surface, not an irradiating physical light.
lights.ownership: City proxy clones borrowed lamp prototype; dedicated signLight clone enters ownedMaterials. GB geometry is owned and collected at flush/root traversal. No new textures, no shared texture disposal, no new Light/shadow map. Existing dispose order city before station remains.
lights.shadow: New lamp boxes and changed sign have shadow:false; this suppresses castShadow, not screen-space AO.

ao.cause: For a perpendicular corner and fixed sample on the other face, C9 cosine product s*t/(s*s+t*t) goes to zero at crease and peaks away; the .08 offsets reinforce the dead zone. This supports a mechanism for radius-separated bands, but is not proof every recorded band has that sole cause.
ao.newFormula: C10 uses receiver cosine minus .08 times smoothstep(-.3,-.05,sample facing), with distance falloff unchanged; removes the second-cosine zero at a true corner. Global normalization changes 6 to2. Screen-space discrete sampling/normal selection means monotonicity of a complete rendered edge is not guaranteed.
ao.emissiveAO: Final composite multiplies combined color, including Basic/self-lit surfaces, by depth AO. Changing to a material emissive property alone cannot exempt the emitted term from this postprocess. A future semantic emission/AO-receive mask or separated emission composite is principled; brightness cutoff is not, as it would exempt lit white walls. No such change implemented.

cpu.reason: Inherited non-occluding sloped plane assertion fails at screen boundary under new gate.
cpu.screenEdgeCause: wbNormal permits out-of-screen clamped depth, whose zero depth difference wins the flatter-side selection. The C10 relaxed facing gate accepts some resulting false occlusion. Only analytic CPU case; not reproduced on actual scene/GPU.
cpu.possibleLocalDirection: If actual screen-edge evidence warrants fixing, choose valid in-bounds one-sided depth differences in wbNormal; no brightness heuristic or global AO strength adjustment.

limits: No GPU run or rendered comparison by this agent.
Derived triangle count is exact delta from unchanged GB box topology and recorded prior total, not a new runtime stats measurement.
CPU nearest Float32 depth with JS double arithmetic; not a GLSL compiler/Float32 execution proof.
Synthetic edge case does not fail this review or imply scene-wide artifacts. Root will decide from fixed-view actual GPU evidence.
No fixture writes, installs, Git mutation or commits.
